title: Covert C2 and Data Staging
story: The SOC observed several recurring outbound connections from internal systems. Some belong to legitimate software update and monitoring services, while others may indicate command-and-control activity. At the same time, sensitive files appear to have been collected into a temporary staging location. Determine whether covert C2 is active and identify what data is being prepared for exfiltration.
objective: Correlate DNS, network flow, HTTP metadata, endpoint process activity and filesystem events to identify covert C2 communication and data staging activity.

questions.label: Identify the host communicating with the malicious C2 infrastructure
Approximately how often does the malicious beacon occur?
Identify the directory used to stage collected data
Identify the archive created for staging
Which sensitive dataset was included in the staged archive?
